examples.explanation: The block "AAAAACCCCC" starts at index 0 and again at index 10; "CCCCCAAAAA" starts at index 5 and again at index 16.
The only length-10 block is ten A's, repeating at every position.
The string is shorter than 10 characters, so nothing qualifies.

hints: Slide a window of width 10 across the string and count how many times each block appears with a hash map.
Append a block to the answer the moment its count reaches 2, so each repeat is reported exactly once.
Only the relative order is irrelevant; comparing answers as sets (or sorted lists) is the robust check.
